recap.text: Through Oct 7, Chugalugs91 leads the real standings with 62 points, with Nick Schmaltz and Sebastian Aho at 7 each. The projections still have them 15th, because much of that pace comes from depth players who aren't expected to keep it up.
recap.impact: Not a threat. Your roster projects 1st from here and theirs 15th, so the 49-point gap should close well before the halfway mark.

recap.text: The projections got an upgrade this week. They now blend in NHL.com's published projections, track ice time and power-play units, and adjust for shooting luck. 97 Problems is the projected favourite at about 19%, with Dom Scavuzzo, PhilCap and Debits & Checks next at 9 to 11%. Peter Will Probably Pick Old Guys fell from 2nd to 6th.
recap.impact: This is the big one for you: you moved from 9th to 2nd projected, with win odds up from 3.8% to about 19%. Treat it as a range rather than a sure thing, because it leans on two sources that disagree about your young players.

recap.text: Connor McDavid leads all pool players with 12 points in 4 games. Evan Bouchard has 11, Jack Eichel 10 and Leon Draisaitl 9, so Edmonton's hot start is driving the top of the scoring list.
recap.impact: McDavid is the swing factor for you, since 97 Problems is the only team projected ahead of you, by 6 points. Every big McDavid week keeps them in front.

recap.text: Lord of the Rinks is last with 13 points, with six players still scoreless. Shot data says a lot of that is luck: Wyatt Johnston and Sam Reinhart have 19 shots combined and no goals.
recap.impact: Expect a bounce. The projections already count Johnston and Reinhart as unlucky rather than slumping, and almost your whole roster is on top power-play units, which is where the points come from.

recap.text: Injury watch: Connor Bedard (Girl on the Lake) is on IR with no timeline, Mathew Barzal (Poppy's Picks) hasn't resumed skating, and Zach Hyman (This Is the Year) is out about two weeks. Evander Kane (Just Here for the Poker) isn't on an NHL roster.
recap.impact: None of these hit 97 Problems, the team you're chasing. Your own concern is Jake Sanderson, who has played once and is listed as injured.
